reviews.text:
Super-stocked shop. Teresa and Daniele are always available and kind.
Highly recommended as a shop for our pets 🐾❤️😍😍 …
Very well stocked shop and excellent prices, Teresa and Daniele are two exceptional people who do their job with love, I recommend this shop
Very good and very professional....thanks for everything.

What can I say, the absolute best. I've been taking my dog ​​to them for 8 years and have always left satisfied. My bulldog is also a very particular dog, a bit aggressive and reactive, and Daniele has never had a problem with that. Top staff, fantastic products, and my puppy always comes out spotless (I bring her black and she comes out white hahahaha). Not to mention that they take care of everything, my little one has her own personal shampoo from them hahahaha

I wouldn't recommend it to anyone, I'm dissatisfied. The work was completely botched and I received unsatisfied requests for my dog's grooming.
The staff was disrespectful and completely unresponsive.
After the mistake, they neither apologized nor made themselves available. Terrible.
I don't recommend it, it's unprofessional.
Very well stocked. My cat Miki loves the papaya and tuna cans that I can only find here.
